preflight scan worker before inserting scan job

known_risks: If PHP-FPM disables proc_open, automatic worker spawn will report an explicit startup error.
Full-scan cancellation remains cooperative during row consumption and may allow a small mid-batch upsert before the next cancellation check.
Clearing active scan jobs cancels/deletes queue state; a worker already inside a row batch stops at its next job-active check.
